actual_scope: Can the production PR886 bit-frame checker (research/bit589-frame-optimum/frameopt.py:close, exercised by research/bit589-frame-optimum/verify.sh on the pinned PR589/PR555/degraded words) adopt the exact one-basis modular closure from research/bit-frame-closure-basis/ so the shipped verify path is faster while every receipt field, stdout digest and complete three-case suite stays identical?
scope_change_reason: The catalogue draw suggested portable-replay; expertise override selected verifier-engineering after profiling showed production frameopt.close still rebuilt a modular elimination per candidate live line. Ross Richardson's incorporated #1666 opt-in adapter already proved an identical-receipt one-basis accelerator; production still paid the pairwise path. Leave-alone objects (joint frames, shared/mixed-point, ternary, parity-side, DisjointTensor.frame_data, verify_factor, leech_minor, sparse-fusion, joint-dual replay, quadratic-affine) and deferred micro-opts were not reopened.
bottleneck_link: Side result on review throughput: the PR886 frame-only optimum is a retained historical obstruction replay. Faster identical close ranks do not change kappa or the binding complex supplier.
ai_assistance: Substantial AI assistance for orientation, overlap search, profiling, production wiring, packaging, benchmarking and writing
evidence: PASS_BIT_FRAME_CLOSURE_PRODUCTION via research/bit-frame-closure-production/verify.py (also under -O); PASS_IDENTICAL_BIT_FRAME_CLOSURE_PRODUCTION_RECEIPTS via benchmark.py; production verify.sh still prints PASS_BIT589_FRAME_OPTIMUM; EXPECTED.json stdout digests unchanged.
author: Wentao Li
stop_rule: Ship an equivalence-preserving production frameopt.close change with frozen baseline, identical three-case receipts and stdout digests, temp-copy corruption rejection, registered replay and a measured before/after median. Do not invent kappa or reopen leave-alone objects.
